spans.s:
लग् लगति pp. लग्न (q.v.) attach or fasten one's self
to (loc.), cling to, adhere, approach, near, follow immediately, happen,
occur, pass away. — अव abide, stay, tarry. आ cling to, adhere.
वि cling or stick to (loc.). — Cf. अनुलग्न, अवलग्न, आलग्न,
परिलग्न*, प्रतिलग्न* (add.), विलग्न, संलग्न.
लगनीय n. impers. (it is) to be clung to (loc.).
लगुडप्रहार m. a blow with a cudgel.

लग्नकाल m. ˚दिन n., ˚दिवस m. auspicious time or
day.
